mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id, geo_id, sta_id, station_code, station_name, warning_type, warning_level, status, no_warning_count, is_released, rain_release_count, last_batch_time, actual_value, forecast_value, forecast_3h_value, forecast_time, forecast_period FROM warning_current_status WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY geo_id, sta_id, warning_type
mapper.update: UPDATE warning_current_status SET station_name = #{record.stationName}, warning_level = #{record.warningLevel}, status = #{record.status}, no_warning_count = #{record.noWarningCount}, is_released = #{record.isReleased}, rain_release_count = #{record.rainReleaseCount}, last_batch_time = #{record.lastBatchTime, typeHandler=com.warning.typehandler.XuguDateTypeHandler}, actual_value = #{record.actualValue}, forecast_value = #{record.forecastValue}, forecast_3h_value= #{record.forecast3hValue}, forecast_time = #{record.forecastTime, typeHandler=com.warning.typehandler.XuguDateTypeHandler}, forecast_period = #{record.forecastPeriod} WHERE plan_id = #{record.planId} AND geo_id = #{record.geoId} AND sta_id = #{record.staId} AND warning_type = #{record.warningType}
